{{Youmay|the Ee mental power|the [[Force power/Legends|Force power]] [[Teleportation (Force power)/Legends|teleport]]}}
'''Teleportation''' was an [[Ee mental power]], and part of the physical skills category. Ee adept in this power could teleport objects weighing a [[Kilogram/Legends|kilogram]] or less, and could also teleport themselves.
